operation.summary: What an applet's portal shows now: the functions its page exposes, the state it published, its visible words, and who used it last (the owner by touch, or an agent)
operation.returns: id, name, kind, open, on_screen, loaded, functions[{name, description, params}], state (the page's own JSON or null), state_at, text (visible words, ≤ 8 KB, null when closed), last_input{by: owner|agent, agent?, function?, at}
